[Unit]
Description=Declared development worker
[Service]
Type=simple
User=stand
ExecStart=/opt/stand/pkgs/dev-worker/bin/worker --wait
Restart=no
KillMode=control-group
TimeoutStopSec=5
MemoryDenyWriteExecute=yes
NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
PrivateTmp=yes
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
